entries.summary: Fixed a build problem that could leave parts of the app missing and cause crashes.
Adding a next point while walking no longer sends you back or loops.
The stop counter for a chain of added points now counts the points you tapped, not every turn of the road. It also grows when you add a point.
Teleport routes now show the stop counter too.
The suggested teleport wait now also shows on the route start sheet and the paste coordinates box, in the app and in the floating widget.
Added Privacy Mode to the GitHub download. It installs a renamed copy of the app, so other apps do not see its name.
